issues.jp_before: 会議[かいぎ]{は|wa-topic}三時[さんじ]{から|kara-from}でした{よね|yone-confirm}。
issues.problem: English 'was from three o'clock' is unnatural.
issues.action: English changed to 'The meeting started at three o'clock, right?'

issues.jp_before: あの人[ひと]{は|wa-topic}たしか医者[いしゃ]だった{よね|yone-confirm}。
issues.problem: Recollective だった means the person is a doctor (as I recall), not that they used to be; English 'was a doctor' misleads and assumed 'he'.
issues.action: English changed to 'If I remember right, that person is a doctor, isn't that so?'

issues.jp_before: 先生[せんせい]{に|ni-target}連絡[れんらく]しました{よね|yone-confirm}。
issues.problem: に with 連絡する marks the person the message goes to (recipient), not a target of contact like 会う/触る.

issues.jp_before: 日本語[にほんご]{の|no-possessive}授業[じゅぎょう]{は|wa-topic}毎週[まいしゅう]月曜日[げつようび]{に|ni-time}あります{よね|yone-confirm}。
issues.problem: English 'is on Mondays every week' is awkward.
issues.action: English changed to 'The Japanese class is every Monday, right?'
